pc_changelog:
v4.3.0 — FlyShelf Optimization Sprint

• Settings I/O debounced: 90% less disk writes during window resize
• Search bar: smooth slide animation + Ctrl+F hint
• Toast notifications: now stack vertically instead of overlapping
• Empty state: actionable quick-start tips with keyboard shortcuts
• All tooltips show keyboard shortcuts on hover
• Cloud echo dict bounded at 100 entries (memory safety)
• Fixed IL3000 warnings in single-file mode
• Removed stale ClipFlow/Advance Hub branding
• Dead code cleanup (25+ lines removed)
